Dear all,

A few last seats are still available for our upcoming online course:

Multivariate Data Analysis with R and vegan


Dates: 4–7 May
 https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/vegan/


This hands-on course covers key methods for analysing multivariate ecological data in R, including ordination (PCA, NMDS, PCoA), constrained methods (RDA, CCA), and PERMANOVA.


 New for the May 2026 edition: expanded content on applying these methods to high-throughput data, including shotgun sequencing (metabarcoding) and metagenomics.

Designed for researchers and PhD students with basic R experience.

If interested, we recommend registering soon as places are limited.

Best regards,
Carlo
